result.topic_en: A bibliographic list of academic writings (apparently by Euler): counts of papers in the St. Petersburg Academy Commentarii, Novi Commentarii and Nova Acta, followed by titles of memoirs in the Paris Academy Mémoires and prize-winning pieces in the Recueil des pièces.
